title: Reviewed-by-desk versus draft stamp on wiki pages
description:
As a reader, I want to see whether a page was reviewed, so that a generated description can never look attested.

Implements the stamp ideas of PPY-964472 for public pages: visible "reviewed by the desk on DATE" versus "draft, not yet reviewed"; superseded pages are marked; a non-LLM checker enforces the stamp.

```gherkin
Feature: Wiki page stamps
  Scenario: Reviewed
    Given a page published after human acceptance
    Then it shows "reviewed" with the date

  Scenario: Unreviewed generated text
    Given a page whose text was generated and not accepted
    Then it is not public

  Scenario: Superseded
    Given a page marked superseded
    Then it shows the superseded notice and links to its replacement
```
